coaching.headline: An allied ace around the Orb Prime take preceded Revenant's Shaper take, and Revenant ran over a tankless team for 20 kills.

flags.text: Orb Prime came with a fucking 0-5 wipe; Revenant then took Shaper and two allied inner towers fell.
Revenant ran the game at 20/7/8, killing Lt. Belica and Sparrow five times each; neither bought physical armor.
No tank against Steel and Aurora, two divers in Bayle and Khaimera, and a mage at support.
Allies took the enemy offlane inhibitor and Shaper, then two inner towers, never the Core.

focus.title: Group for Prime, then end
focus.action: Draft one tank; start Orb Prime and Shaper only with five grouped and Steel's Shield Slam spent; Lt. Belica and Sparrow add physical armor; after an enemy inhibitor falls, push the Core.

24.2.call: Lost 0-5 around the allied Orb Prime take: Khaimera, Bayle and Lt. Belica died at the Prime pit, Sparrow in the allied jungle. Locate Revenant and Wukong before starting Orb Prime.

28.3.call: Lost 3-5: Revenant killed Lt. Belica, Bayle and Sparrow, and Renna scored all three allied kills. Wukong then took the allied offlane inhibitor. With three allies down, back off and defend the inhibitor.

38.5.call: Lost 2-4 with Renna scoring both allied kills; two allied inhibitors fell, then Steel finished the Core. In the final fights, wait for Steel's Shield Slam before committing.

b30729da-2b5d-414d-9269-c51338e4ec8b: Eleven deaths against an own average of 5.4, five to Revenant, with no armor or tenacity built. Once Revenant gets ahead, make World Breaker the next buy.
Ran the vision: 16 wards against an own average of 7.3, plus all 3 allied ward clears. If a sentry is equipped, sweep each Prime pit first.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Thirteen deaths, the most in the game, five to Wukong; one outside any detected fight came just before the first enemy Fangtooth. Next Fangtooth, group with mid and duo first.
Output held: 632 hero damage a minute against an own average of 417, plus Mini Prime and the second Orb Prime. With a Prime up, keep claiming the last hit.
acaa4b6b-345e-4895-b240-8ad5dc9c4554: Three of eight deaths came outside any detected fight, to Wukong, Steel and Revenant. When Revenant or Steel is missing from view, back off first.
Credited with the enemy offlane inner tower. With that lane open, push toward the offlane inhibitor whenever Wukong shows on another lane.
5ae9c36f-ef96-442b-968d-c5fa57436c7a: The damn engine: 88037 hero damage, most in the game, and 2201 a minute against an own average of 1173. Keep that output from the back edge of fights.
Eight deaths, more than double an own average, and no physical armor while taking mostly physical damage. Once Revenant or Legion gets ahead, buy physical armor next.
09479c78-444a-45e6-9a0c-cf4d7e7a1173: Eleven deaths, nearly triple an own average, five to Revenant. Sidestep the Scar orb that sets up the root, and buy Equinox for tenacity once Revenant gets ahead.
Farm fell to 5.7 CS a minute against an own average of 8.5, and gold trailed Legion 17.6k to 21.5k. Between fights, clear the duo wave before joining river plays.

matchup: This support field wins 46.1% into Steel, and the duo lane read even against Legion and Steel.
build: Went physical on-hit instead of the Crescelia, Tainted Scepter, Dynamo core that wins 54.4% into Steel.
Hero damage split nearly evenly: 13285 physical and 14615 magical.
Imperator came last, so the 30% critical strike damage bonus missed the earlier fights.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed; this support took 199 minions.
Cull the Weak adds minion and monster damage, little help to a support's fights.
Lotus leads this support field on a toss-up with Weald; Xyris has too few games to lead.
augment: Pulsefire Rounds adds on-hit damage to basic attacks, matching the physical build.
Combat Veteran leans ahead in this support field; Pulsefire Rounds ranks third.
crest: Reclamation raises the ward cap from two to three, fitting 16 wards placed.
Reclamation's Purify active cleanses the user and nearby allies.
Tranquility leans ahead in this support field's crests; Reclamation ranks well below.
improvement: Not built: World Breaker for tenacity against four extra enemy hard-CC abilities.
Not built: physical armor; 19506 of the damage taken from heroes was physical.
Not built: magical armor into Steel; Steel wins this lane 53.9%.

matchup: Jungle opponent Aurora; this jungle field wins 50.6% into Aurora.
Aurora never killed this jungler; Wukong, Revenant and Legion split all thirteen deaths.
Gold trailed Aurora 15.4k to 18.1k despite 18 enemy-jungle minions taken.
build: Off the Malady, Terminus, Necrosis core that wins 62.6% for this jungle field.
Ashbringer's Chrono Strikes cut non-ultimate cooldowns on basic-attack hits, more on critical strikes.
Forticus came last, so the armor and tenacity were absent from earlier fights.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage to that target, less taken back.
Lotus leans ahead in this jungle field; Thraex ranks last of the listed Eternals.
Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the top Thraex pair. Sound keep within Thraex.
augment: Feral Ambush adds 10% range to Ambush.
Jungle Invasion is Best in this jungle field; Feral Ambush is more played but ranks second.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Pacifier leads this jungle field's crests on a toss-up with Gravitum; Judgement ranks sixth.
improvement: Void Helm is bought more into Aurora, 17% against a usual 9%, at a 54% win rate.
Tenacity and physical armor were covered by Forticus; keep that answer, just earlier.
Jungle Invasion over Feral Ambush is the field-backed swap: jungle physical power instead of Ambush range.

threats: Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
ourKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
ourKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
ourKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
ourKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
ourKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Pole Vault leap in (Body) → High Impact slam slow → switch stance → Cyclebreaker spin and stun throw → Windsurge dash
enemyKits.winCondition: swap stances for the right tool and keep damaging enemies to spawn clones that add pressure
enemyKits.passive: Somersault lets him double jump into the air
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who fight alongside his clones and follow up on his stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; avoid the Cyclebreaker throw stun, and wait out its damage-reduction spin before bursting him

enemyKits.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
enemyKits.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
enemyKits.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
enemyKits.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

Out-tanked 0 v 2: teams two tanks down won 45.7% in 1.18.
2 divers (Bayle, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
Lt. Belica at support is a mage: nobody stays with the carry.

lines: Lead story: Soaked the fights. 1,448 damage mitigated a minute, more than 98% of Revenant mid players this patch.
Revenant dealt 52,555 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +220 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Lt. Belica (level 17 estimated: about 115 physical armor, 75 after penetration) and Sparrow (level 17 estimated: about 102 physical armor, 65 after penetration) that is about 23% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Forticus (item): Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.
Forticus (item): Upon damaging or being damaged by Heroes: For the next 3s, gain Stats each second: (+0.6% Base Health) additional Max Health, +4 Movement Speed and +0.5% Size.

Sustain: 15% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Forticus: Upon taking Hero damage: Gain a (+8%) Shield for 3.5s.; Forticus: Shield Activations: Hero Combat Time:; 1,406 healing recorded.
Toughness: +325 health, +55 physical armor, +25% tenacity; took 49,093 damage, mitigated 57,914, died 7 times.

Lesson: Revenant's penetration cut through: Lt. Belica took about 23% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 115, about 75 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Demolisher, Forticus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Revenant killed built physical armor (Khaimera, Bayle). We killed Revenant 7 times.
Copy it? Too few Revenant midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.

Lesson: Renna's penetration cut through: Legion took about 23% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 45, about 19 after 11 flat + 35% penetration).

They brought 11 hard-CC abilities to our 7. Fight after Steel's Shield Slam and Aurora's Hoarfrost and Aurora's Cryoseism are used, spread out instead of grouping in a line, and the front line can buy tenacity.

Theirs: Aurora Hoarfrost, Aurora Cryoseism, Wukong Windsurge/Force Push, Wukong Cyclebreaker/High Impact, Revenant Scar, Revenant Reckoning, Steel Shield Bash, Steel Bull Rush, Steel Shield Slam, Legion Frag Order, Legion Rally Point.

bullets: Fate and Obliterate hits stacked Knell's Rust on heroes, shredding both armors; Revenant gained armor from the shred, and Fracture added damage at maximum Rust.
Patina gave a shield after a stretch without taking damage, plus movement speed while the shield held; Forticus shielded Revenant on taking hero damage, on a cooldown.
Fate's final round always critically strikes; Hellfire Rounds set critical damage higher by rank, Imperator added 30% more, and Bounty Hunter scaled Physical Power with critical strike chance.
Nightfall healed Wukong for 6% of ability damage to heroes, and Windsurge/Force Push and Cyclebreaker/High Impact hit areas; Taproot healed on basic attack hits, never from towers.
Weald fired true-damage missiles after Wukong damaged a hero below a health threshold, on a per-hero cooldown; Forage added gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Tainted Blade cut the target's healing by 45% for 3s on physical damage, and The Perforator slowed targets of ability damage by 10% for 1s.
Stupor hit several heroes at once, setting off Entropy, Megacosm's damage over time, Caustica against bonus Magical Armor on targets above 50% Health, and Wraith Leggings below 40%.
Prima Donna raised Stupor and Abyssal Rift damage to heroes, with more damage taken; Lotus added random stats over time and per takedown; Early Bloom added one level.
Renna's magical damage through Tainted Scepter cut target healing 45% for 4s; 35 ability haste from Entropy, Megacosm and Tainted Scepter brought Abyssal Rift back 26% sooner.

coachLean.headline: Zero tanks into two and 11 hard-CC abilities to 7: the team lost 9 of 17 fights while Revenant went 20/7/8.

flags.text: Orb Prime came with five allied deaths; the enemy then took the Shaper and two inner towers.

focus.action: Open fights with Seismic Assault near walls, chain Cull then Stupor, and engage only after Shield Slam and Hoarfrost are spent; start Orb Prime only after a won fight.
